action_summary: Prefer the single-fold exp301-1-large-itpt10-f0 experiment associated with v52 (0.81978), with a file-checked fallback to the existing v54 four-fold ensemble. Treat --weights correctly as rounding cutoffs. Calibrate cutoffs from compatible saved held-out predictions in the selected experiment only, verify essay IDs and labels against train.csv, regularize cutoff movement, and select shrinkage using stratified cross-validation with a minimum improvement gate. Retain the existing cutoffs when evidence is unavailable or insufficient, since the exact v52 cutoffs are not supplied. Align the submission by essay_id, validate integer scores, load checkpoint tensors via CPU, and save raw predictions plus calibration metadata. No training or inference was run locally; improvements depend on the mounted artifacts and require leaderboard evaluation.
